name: Felzenswalb Distance Transform
definition: A method to calculate the exact Euclidean distance field from a binary volume in only 3 passes, without propagation errors or numerical errors. It is used to generate the scalar distance field required for isosurface extraction.
summary: The Felzenswalb Distance Transform computes exact Euclidean distances from binary volumes in three passes, offering superior efficiency and parallelizability over approximate methods.
